name: Side step
summary: Small side steps that keep you balanced and facing the ball.
whenToUse: For almost every ball that is not right at you: a short distance to the side.

keyPoints.stance: Ready stance: feet wider than shoulders, knees bent.
keyPoints.bodyAction: Push off the foot further from where you are going; the foot nearer the ball moves first, the other follows. Feet never cross.
keyPoints.strokeLength: Footwork only: the stroke happens as the step finishes.
keyPoints.timing: Start moving as soon as you read the direction of the ball.
keyPoints.tablePosition: Wherever the ball takes you; come back to the middle.
keyPoints.freeArm: Up and in front for balance.
keyPoints.batArm: Bat stays in front while you move.
keyPoints.recovery: Side step back toward the middle after each shot.
keyPoints.anticipation: Watch the opponent's bat: it tells you the direction early.

learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.
4 rounds staying low, then yes to the self-checks.
selfChecks: Did your head stay at the same height?
Did you push off the far foot?

learningPath.task: Two-point footwork at an easy pace.
Two-point footwork until 12 in a row.
In and out, and side to side.

gamePatterns.situation: A wide ball to your forehand in a rally.
gamePatterns.how: Two quick side steps, play, two side steps back to the middle.

fixes: Move as soon as you read the direction
Step back to the middle every time
